note: paper config (push_box specialist): 64 starts x 8 candidates per round, 6-chunk windows, lr 1e-4, 24 AdamW steps per round, EMA 0.5, beta 0.1, reference weight 1, LoRA r32/a32, reward scale frozen at r00; start pool 80 scenes x 2 teacher seeds (16 probe + 64 training scenes); rows 8 (8 scene workers per GPU process) and sampled rendering as in the paper runs (8 GPUs). The paper specialist is round r14. Acceleration: rows only changes throughput (starts, candidates, seeds, samples per round and gradient batches are unchanged); row-batched and row-by-row sampling agree only to bf16 rounding, so trajectories are not bit-identical (with rows 1 every candidate rebuilds its start history on its own, which is much slower). render_mode sampled gives bit-identical policy frames. rows, learn_batch and render_mode may change when a run resumes.
